about: Column map for one billing CSV format, read by scripts/focus_export.py convert. Copy it to <provider>-<format>.json and replace every placeholder; the script stops while a placeholder is left. columns: FOCUS column to the column name in the billing file. constants: values for every row; a mapped column overrides a constant when the cell is not empty. values: translations of cell values, per FOCUS column. tags: tag key to source column, written as a JSON object into Tags. extra: custom columns, with the x_ prefix. date_format: iso, or a strptime format such as %d.%m.%Y. decimal: . or , for the decimal mark. granularity: day or month, for rows without an end date.
source: <provider> <name of the export or invoice series>
